visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with short dark hair and bangs, wearing a pink spaghetti-strap tank top, stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds a rose gold Dreame hair dryer, gesturing with it as she speaks directly toward the lens. The background shows a cream-colored wall, a dark door, and some cluttered furniture on a table. (2) A quick montage sequence follows, showing the woman at various iconic travel destinations including the beach in front of the Burj Al Arab in Dubai and the ancient mountain ruins of Machu Picchu in Peru. She is smiling and interacting with her hair while wearing different summer outfits. (3) Returning to the indoor room, she demonstrates the folding mechanism of the hair dryer. She uses both hands to twist the handle, showing how the device collapses into a compact form. The lighting remains warm and consistent, highlighting the metallic texture of the product. (4) Close-up shots feature the hair dryer placed next to a clear-cased iPhone on a white bed sheet to compare their sizes. Her hands are seen manipulating the device and the phone. Text overlays appear frequently in the center of the frame. (5) The woman is seen using the hair dryer on her hair in a bedroom setting with a large mirror. She brushes through her hair while drying it to show the smooth and shiny finish. She then demonstrates attaching accessories like a styling nozzle and packing the device into a grey storage bag. (6) In the final phase, she holds the folded hair dryer close to her face and gestures downward toward the bottom of the frame. Large text overlays showing the price and a call to action appear prominently on the screen.
